table_name: EXCEPTION SUMMARY  –  TYPE / MEANING / POSSIBLE REASONS

body.Exception Type: GRPO Posted but No AP Invoice (Goods Received, Invoice Pending)
body.Business Meaning: Material has been received and GRPO posted but vendor invoice not yet matched. This is GR/IR (Goods Received Invoice Received) pending.
body.Possible Reasons: Invoice in transit; pending verification; payment terms allow delay; vendor delayed sending invoice.

body.Exception Type: Gate Entry Open without GRPO (Material at Gate not Posted to System)
body.Business Meaning: Material physically arrived at gate but inward GRPO not posted in books. Material movement not reflected in accounts.
body.Possible Reasons: Security/Gate department not closing entry; GRPO clerk not posting; rejected/returned material.

body.Exception Type: AP Invoice Booked without Gate Entry (Possible Direct Posting / Service Bills)
body.Business Meaning: AP Invoice exists in accounts but no Gate Entry record found. Often valid for services, freight, or expense invoices (no goods inward).
body.Possible Reasons: Service bills, freight bills, professional fees, utility bills, journal entries - these do not require gate entry.
